repositories.name: cordis
repositories.summary: Cordis 是一个时空组合性的元框架，提供编程范式以支持时空组合，目前处于积极开发阶段。

repositories.name: diagram-design
repositories.description: 29 editorial diagram types for Claude Code. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows, no Mermaid-slop.
repositories.summary: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编程工具提供 29 种编辑级 HTML+SVG 图表模板的插件，可生成无阴影、非 Mermaid 风格的自包含图表。

repositories.name: plugins
repositories.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
repositories.summary: Cursor 官方插件仓库，收录面向开发者工具、框架和 SaaS 产品的插件，每个插件含独立清单文件。

repositories.name: needle
repositories.description: 14MB foundation model for tiny devices; phones, wearables, smart home, and robots.
repositories.summary: Needle 2 是一个面向工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取的 45M 参数开源模型，整体仅 14MB，可在约 28MB 内存中运行完整会话。

repositories.name: unsloth
repositories.description: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, FLUX and more.
repositories.summary: Unsloth 是一个本地桌面应用，用于运行和训练大语言模型及扩散模型，支持微调、强化学习等，并兼容多种硬件平台。

repositories.name: public-apis
repositories.description: A collective list of free APIs
repositories.summary: 这是一个由社区维护的免费公共API集合列表，按类别整理，方便开发者查找和使用。

repositories.name: Soup
repositories.description: Fine-tune LLMs from one YAML. Layer streaming trains an 8B model on a 4 GB laptop GPU.
repositories.summary: Soup 是一个通过 YAML 配置即可微调大语言模型的命令行工具，支持多种训练任务，并能在低显存 GPU 上运行。

repositories.name: spec-kit
repositories.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development
repositories.summary: Spec Kit 是一个开源工具包，通过规范驱动开发流程，帮助用户在使用任意 AI 编程代理时先定义再构建软件。

repositories.name: holehe
repositories.description: holehe allows you to check if the mail is used on different sites like twitter, instagram and will retrieve information on sites with the forgotten password function.
repositories.summary: holehe 是一个 Python 工具，通过检查邮箱在 Twitter、Instagram 等网站是否注册，利用忘记密码功能获取相关信息。

repositories.name: FluidVoice
repositories.description: Fastest and only macOS Dictation app with on-device STT and custom trained AI enhancement model. A local Wispr Flow alternative. DM us on X for an easter egg 😉 - https://x.com/fluidvoiceapp
repositories.summary: FluidVoice 是一款开源的 macOS 语音转文字听写应用，支持设备端 AI 增强、命令模式和写作模式，可离线运行。

repositories.name: ToolJet
repositories.description: ToolJet is the open-source foundation of ToolJet AI - the enterprise app generation platform for building internal tools, dashboard, business applications, workflows and AI agents 🚀
repositories.summary: ToolJet 是一个开源低代码平台，用于快速构建内部工具、仪表盘、业务应用和工作流，并支持连接多种数据源。

repositories.name: CLI-Anything
repositories.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
repositories.summary: CLI-Anything 是一个为 AI 智能体生成命令行接口的工具，让软件能被智能体直接调用。

repositories.name: ego-lite
repositories.description: The fastest browser for AI agents to run browser automation, built for sharing your logged-in browser state with your AI agents, like Codex or Claude Code, without disturbing you. Zero cost, zero config.
repositories.summary: ego-lite 是一款专为 AI 代理设计的浏览器，可共享登录状态并高效执行自动化任务。
